name: civitai-sveltekit-app-starter
description: SvelteKit 2 starter for building Civitai OAuth + Buzz-powered apps.
comment-overrides: SECURITY CONSTRAINTS ON TRANSITIVE DEPENDENCIES. Declared HERE, in the
starter's own manifest, because that is what travels: `npx tiged
civitai/civitai-app-starters/starters/sveltekit-app my-app` copies this
directory alone, and the monorepo root's pnpm.overrides is NOT part of the
copy. Before this existed a scaffolded copy resolved cookie@0.6.0 and
`npm audit` reported 3 low advisories (GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x) while the
monorepo installed cookie@0.7.x and CI was green.
cookie: @sveltejs/kit@2.70.3 (latest) still declares `cookie: ^0.6.0` and
there is no fixed kit release to bump to, so the constraint is the fix.
postcss: mirrors the root for consistency; no starter resolves a postcss
below 8.5.10 today, so it is a no-op with no referent.
BOTH blocks on purpose: `overrides` is npm's key, `pnpm.overrides` is
pnpm's, and an external developer may reach for either. The `@<range>`
SELECTOR spelling is used in both -- npm accepts it, and unlike the bare
spelling it does not trip `EOVERRIDE` where the manifest also depends on
the package directly.
EXPECTED NOISE: a workspace `pnpm install` prints `The field
"pnpm.overrides" was found in ... This will not take effect` for this file.
That warning is correct -- inside the monorepo only the ROOT manifest's
overrides apply -- and it is not a reason to delete this block: the block is
for the tiged'd copy, where this manifest IS the root. Measured: pnpm does
NOT read the plain `overrides` key (a scaffolded copy carrying only that key
resolved cookie@0.6.0), so both blocks are load-bearing.
Enforced by scripts/check-starter-workspace-overrides.mjs rule 4.
